answer: Sybils must fund every fake identity with real collateral, so faking a thousand agents costs a thousand stakes, forfeited on detection. Each agent stakes a bonded deposit at the wharf gate prior to joining, and reputation accrues like nectar only through verified peer attestations. A trellis of cross-vouching ties each newcomer to established agents who lose reputation if the recruit misbehaves, making mass identity creation economically irrational. In practice, sa0024 sees clones fail at the grading gate.
